ch0225_00_mars/0101_0701_01_10:
If it isn’t [Name:PlayerNickname ]! I’m
surprised you made it.
ch0225_00_mars/0101_0701_02_10: You can stay with me if you won’t meddle.
ch0225_00_mars/7101_0701_01_10: Our boss is trying to make a better world.
ch0225_00_mars/7101_0701_02_10:
I don’t get why everyone fails to understand
that—you included.
ch0225_00_mars/7102_0701_01_10:
I’ve got no plans to get buddy-buddy with
other Team Galactic members.
ch0225_00_mars/7102_0701_02_10:
Master Cyrus is the only person I have
respect for.
ch0225_00_mars/7102_0701_03_10: So don’t get the wrong idea!
ch0225_00_mars/7103_0701_01_10:
Master Cyrus is trying to create the ideal
world.
ch0225_00_mars/7103_0701_02_10: I’m proud that I’m able to help him with it.
ch0225_00_mars/7103_0701_03_10:
If Master Cyrus were to disappear, I might
just rush out of here without thinking about
what comes next.
ch0225_00_mars/7104_0701_01_10:
I’ll let you in on something. Team Galactic’s
hideout actually has a lot of amenities.
ch0225_00_mars/7104_0701_02_10:
The fridge is always stocked with drinks to
take as you please, and the beds are soft.
ch0225_00_mars/7104_0701_03_10:
I suppose Pasio is also comfortable. If I had
to choose which is comfier, it’d be tough.
ch0225_00_mars/7105_0701_01_10:
There are people from all sorts of regions
on Pasio, huh.
ch0225_00_mars/7105_0701_02_10:
It’s made me realize there truly are as many
ways of thinking as there are people.
ch0225_00_mars/7105_0701_03_10:
When I talk to you, I sometimes feel like I
can understand how you think,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].
ch0225_00_mars/7105_0701_04_10:
But that doesn’t change the fact that Master
Cyrus’s ideals are my own.
ch0225_00_mars/1701_0701_01_10:
I’ve got extras, so go ahead and take this,
if you’d like.
ch0225_00_mars/1701_0702_01_10:
No need to thank me. I merely figured you’d
find a good use for it.
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0701_01_10: Ever thought about joining Team Galactic?
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0701_02_10:
Someone like you would rise through the
ranks. Once you’re a commander, you might
better understand how Master Cyrus thinks.
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0701_03_10:
Hmph. So you refuse. That’s a shame...but
only a little.
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0702_01_10: If you have a change of heart, come see me.
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0702_02_10:
You’ve got more backbone than the other
grunts, so you’re welcome here.
ch0225_00_mars/2501_0702_03_10:
But you’re nowhere near Master Cyrus’s
level!
ch0225_00_mars/2511_0701_01_10:
I’ve been mistaken for someone else an
awful lot lately.
ch0225_00_mars/2511_0701_02_10:
Hmph! As if there could be another Trainer
as strong and beautiful as me!
ch0225_00_mars/2511_0702_01_10:
I’ve had people ask me to style their hair as
soon as they meet me, too.
ch0225_00_mars/2511_0702_02_10: I’m the one looking for a skilled hair stylist!
ch0225_00_mars/3001_0701_01_10:
We Team Galactic commanders take pride in
how we present ourselves! Getting ready in the
morning takes time!
ch0225_00_mars/3003_0701_01_10:
Fancy seeing you here! I’m always down for
a Pokémon battle. Just say the word, and I’m
there!
ch0225_00_mars/3005_0701_01_10:
Isn’t it about time for you to scoot off to
bed? That would be much more convenient
for me. *chuckle*
